result.summary: Found 4 issues: content duplication in the 'Fastest near you' section, a cut-off card at the screen edge, and minor layout/cropping concerns.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same delivery time and price, appearing to be duplicated content rather than distinct restaurant options.
issues.suggestion: Verify data source and ensure unique restaurants are displayed, or remove duplicate entry.

issues.description: The third card 'Smash Bros Burgers' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating a horizontal scroll list without a clear visual cue (like a partial card or scroll indicator) that it's scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient or partial card preview to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The pizza image card at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cropped by the viewport/bottom navigation bar, cutting off content awkwardly.
issues.suggestion: Adjust scroll padding or spacing so cards aren't harshly cut off by the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The food bowl icons used for both 'Green Bowl Poké' entries look like generic placeholder icons rather than actual food photography, inconsistent with the more detailed imagery used in the 'Popular right now' section.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent high-quality food photography across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
